# Dubliners Madrid

> Dubliners is an Irish pub in central Madrid at Calle de Espoz y Mina 7, 28012 Madrid, a couple of minutes from Puerta del Sol. It occupies the former Barragán tailor shop (established 1885) and keeps the original painted ceiling. Known for NFL and American sports, rugby and live sport on a big projector and 8 screens, an international crowd and English-speaking staff. Open every day from 12:00 (until 02:00 Sunday–Thursday, 02:30 Friday–Saturday). Metro Sol (L1, L2, L3) or Sevilla (L2).

Note: 1885 is the founding year of the Barragán tailor shop that occupied the premises, not of the pub.
